sharedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single fantasy inventory equipment PNG for a game, part of a coherent 64-icon set. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match reference iron/steel sword and shield: bold smooth dark-black rounded outlines, cute chunky compact silhouette, clean cartoon 2D drawing, flat vivid material colors, one broad highlight and one simple shadow shape, minimal internal detail, readable at 32 to 64 pixels. Square canvas; exactly ONE item centered, entire object visible, 72-78% occupancy with clear margin. Truly transparent background with alpha, including holes and openings. No text, labels, numerals, UI, border, backdrop, painted checkerboard, ground, cast shadow, watermark, character, realism, complex texture, or floating particles. Decoration belongs on the item itself. Keep shapes simple despite higher rarity.
